exercises.prompt: Which pattern is a plural of paucity (jamʿ al-qillah, denoting 3–10)?
exercises.explanation: The four patterns of paucity are أَفْعُلٌ, أَفْعَالٌ, أَفْعِلَةٌ, and فِعْلَةٌ.

feedback.rule: Jamʿ al-qillah = أَفْعُلٌ, أَفْعَالٌ, أَفْعِلَةٌ, فِعْلَةٌ.

exercises.prompt: True or False: أَقَاوِيلُ (from أَقْوَالٌ, from قَوْلٌ) is an example of a plural of a plural (jamʿ al-jamʿ).
exercises.explanation: True. Classical Arabic occasionally forms a secondary plural on a broken plural to indicate abundance.

feedback.rule: Jamʿ al-jamʿ is formed from an existing broken plural.
